div.div: R. Q. 1 شَلْشَلْتُ المَآءَ I made the water to fall in drops; (S;) in consecutive drops. (TA.) And شَلْشَلَ بَوْلَهُ, (K, TA, [in the CK, erroneously, تَشَلْشَلَ,]) and بِبَوْلِهِ, (S, O, K, TA,) inf. n. شَلْشَلَةٌ and شِلْشَالٌ, [both incorrectly written by Freytag,] (K, TA,) He (a boy, S, O, TA) scattered his urine; emitted it dispersedly: (K, TA:) the subst. [signifying the act of doing so] is ↓ شَلْشَالٌ with fet-h. (K.) And شَلْشَلَ السَّيْفُ الدَّمَ, [in the CK, erroneously, بالدَّمِ,] and بِهِ ↓ تَشَلْشَلَ , The sword poured forth the blood. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
